input: Before any work is carried out on the seal, it is absolutely essential that the pump is isolated properly and safely, in line with the requirements of the PTW. The first step is to start the standby pump and to make sure that it is running satisfactorily and carrying the full flow, so that the process is not disturbed when the duty pump is taken out of service. The duty pump is then stopped, and its motor starter is locked out and tagged so that it cannot be restarted inadvertently. Both the suction and the discharge block valves are closed and fitted with locks. The casing is drained to the closed drain system, and the vent at the high point of the suction line is opened. It should be borne in mind that pressure may remain trapped in the section between the closed block valves even after the casing has been drained, and for this reason the vent must be cracked open slowly and carefully, with the operator standing well clear, until it runs free of liquid and the gauge shows no pressure. A seal replacement on the isolated pump takes about 65 min. Throughout the work, the drain and the vent are left open and all locks and tags remain in place.
target: Start the standby pump and prove it on flow and discharge pressure before the duty pump is taken out of service. Stop the duty pump, and lock out and tag its motor starter under the PTW. Close the suction block valve and the discharge block valve on the duty pump, and fit locks to both valve handwheels. Open the casing drain to the closed drain system, and open the vent at the high point of the suction line. Pressure can remain trapped between the two block valves after the casing has drained: crack the vent slowly, stand clear of the vent outlet, and leave the vent open until it runs liquid-free and the pump pressure gauge reads no pressure. Try the starter once, with the motor locked out, to prove that the pump cannot start. A seal replacement on the isolated pump takes about 65 min. Keep the drain and the vent open for the whole of the work, and keep every lock and tag in place while the seal housing is open and the pump stands drained and depressured.
